name: SteamSpy API
tagline: Steam ownership and sales estimates by app ID for market research
description: SteamSpy provides public API access to estimated Steam game ownership ranges, player counts, playtime, concurrent users, prices, tags, genres, and related metrics without authentication. Its figures are estimates based on sampled Steam profiles. “Owned” does not mean “sold”: ownership can include retail activations, bundles, gifts, promotions, and free weekends.

auth.details: No API key or authentication required. Public GET endpoints accept query parameters only.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public access; limited to 1 request per second generally and 1 request per 60 seconds for request=all.

rate_limits: 1 request per second generally; request=all is limited to 1 request per 60 seconds and returns 1,000 games per page.
use_cases: get ownership and sales estimate ranges for a Steam app by ID
list all tracked Steam games with player and owner metrics
filter Steam games by genre or tag for market research
fetch top games by concurrent players or owners
compare estimated player engagement (playtime, CCU) across titles
